title: Optimization Problems with Nearly Convex Objective Functions and Nearly Convex Constraint Sets
summary: To every nearly convex optimization problem, that is a minimization problem with a nearly convex objective function and a nearly convex constraint set, we associate a uniquely defined convex optimization problem with a lower semicontinuous objective function and a closed constraint set. Interesting relationships between the original nearly convex problem and the associated convex problem are established.
